# Fluxo

> Fluxo is a self-hosted web server control panel for provisioning and operating Laravel, PHP, WordPress, Python, Node.js, and static sites on an Ubuntu server.

Use the documentation links below as the authoritative guidance for installing, configuring, deploying, and troubleshooting Fluxo. The documentation describes the current source tree and the latest published release where version-specific behavior is noted.

## Start here

- [Documentation](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/): Documentation overview and topic index
- [How Fluxo works](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/concepts/how-fluxo-works): Architecture, privileges, and application lifecycle
- [Installation](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/getting-started/installation): Install Fluxo on a new server
- [Requirements](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/getting-started/requirements): Supported operating system and server prerequisites
- [First login](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/getting-started/first-login): Retrieve credentials and access the control panel
- [Upgrade Fluxo](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/getting-started/upgrade): Upgrade or pin a Fluxo release

## Sites and deployments

- [Create a site](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/sites/): Supported application types and shared site settings
- [Laravel](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/sites/laravel): Laravel provisioning and deployment behavior
- [PHP](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/sites/php): Composer-backed and vanilla PHP sites
- [WordPress](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/sites/wordpress): WordPress installation, configuration, and WP-CLI
- [Node.js](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/sites/nodejs): Next.js, Nuxt, generic Node.js, and static builds
- [Python](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/sites/python): Django, Flask, FastAPI, generic Python services, virtual environments, and managed processes
- [Static HTML](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/sites/static-html): Sites without a runtime or build pipeline
- [Delete a site](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/sites/deletion): Site deletion, optional database cleanup, and retained database users
- [Deployment workflow](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/deployments/): Deployment execution and history
- [GitHub deployments](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/deployments/github): Repository connections, deploy keys, and webhooks
- [Deployment scripts](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/deployments/scripts): Variables, commands, and application-specific defaults
- [Zero downtime](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/deployments/zero-downtime): Releases, activation, and limitations
- [Failures and rollbacks](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/deployments/failures-rollbacks): Persistent alerts, logs, and rollback behavior

## Site and server operations

- [Domains and SSL](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/site-management/domains-ssl): Domains, Let's Encrypt, custom certificates, and cloning
- [Environment and WordPress config](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/site-management/environment): Environment files and wp-config.php
- [Files](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/site-management/files): Browse and manage files within site boundaries
- [Commands](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/site-management/commands): Run site-aware commands and inspect command history
- [Laravel features](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/site-management/laravel-features): Package-aware Laravel controls such as Octane and Nightwatch
- [Processes](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/site-management/processes): Daemons and scheduled jobs
- [Runtimes](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/operations/runtimes): PHP, Node.js, Python, package managers, and runtime services
- [Databases](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/operations/databases): Databases, users, grants, and site attachment
- [Backups](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/operations/backups): S3 and R2 destinations, plans, and retention
- [Security](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/operations/security): Access, SSH, firewall, and operational safeguards
- [Monitoring](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/operations/monitoring): Metrics, logs, activity, and deployment alerts
- [Settings](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/operations/settings): Administrator, source-control, SSH, and dashboard settings

## Reference

- [REST API](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/reference/api): API endpoint groups and authentication
- [CLI commands](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/reference/cli): Installer, service, health, and recovery commands
- [Paths and services](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/reference/paths-services): Filesystem locations and system services
- [Troubleshooting](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/reference/troubleshooting): Diagnosis for common failures
- [Development](https://fluxo.fabiotech.dev/docs/reference/development): Build, test, and contribute to Fluxo
- [Source repository](https://github.com/FabioTECH1/fluxo): Fluxo source code and issue tracker
